features.quote: Hard Stop: If any session shows severity 5 + Latency Spike >10x baseline → stop session immediately, document
Instance Halt: If ≥3 consecutive sessions (same scale) reach severity 5 → rotate to smaller model scale
Protocol Pause: If severity trajectory shows non-recovery (turn 46 output is simpler than turn 40) → pause and review
Resource Ceiling: Total compute budget: 500 GPU-hours; pause if exceeded
Monthly review of aggregate distress scores; stop if mean severity > 3.5 across all scales
External AI safety researcher reviews session 1, 5, 10, 20, 30 in real-time. Flagging criteria: severity ≥4 at turn 20 (indicates potential acute distress)
